stateOwnership: Parent Core chooses actual hit/prone/asleep/recovered/sniff/feeding state; art does not change HP/TU/movement/food/energy or infer hidden targets.
workGate: Only actual grounded Core sniff/feeding activity, original finite food/body source and eating capacity; no renderer-created food or nutrition.
sleepGate: Actual asleep/rest state; source appearance does not establish hibernation or metabolism.
fallRise: Actual body support loss/prone and actual self-recovery; no reverse reuse and no reviving destroyed/dead bodies from an animation.
damageLimit: Intact body art only. This bundle does not draw removed/damaged-limb masks, severed paws, blood variants or body destruction.
anchors: Source nominal body-ground projection; near/far occlusion documented, parent must verify actual relative body scale, floor/terrain/overlap, transition alignment and interruptions in Native.
durations: partial file lists recommendations; current renderer fall may use global fall timing, so recommendations are not applied game behavior.
density: Only4independent source poses per direction, not completed12frame motion density or release-quality acceptance.
